tips.text: Rank the Akstiletto to 30 before building the Aksomati; the build consumes it and you lose that Mastery otherwise.
Start the Tenno Lab research first, then gather the rest while its 72 hours tick.
Keep the built Akstiletto until the Aksomati craft; do not sell it or feed it to anything else first.
Treat the base Aksomati as a trivial pickup; the 200 Cryotic is the mildest part of the chain.
